gen-unifrakturmaguntia-bitter: Bitter brings a slab-serif body with a very large lowercase eye and an s you can see straight through. UnifrakturMaguntia above it is all gothic command, its words tightly clustered.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-mulish: Gothic swagger up top, tightly clustered and lofty, all from UnifrakturMaguntia. Mulish handles the approachable part, with a large x-height and strokes drawn to a single line width.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-rubik: Gothic and commanding, UnifrakturMaguntia packs its words close with a lofty, tall lowercase. Rubik then reads soft and clean, its big lowercase and open round letters staying legible line after line.
gen-almendra-display-gf-abyssinica-sil: Abyssinica SIL carries a literary hush, with a big, tall middle zone and a quiet, watercolor-like shift in line weight. Almendra Display handles the ornate flourish, never pinching its letters shut.
gen-almendra-display-gf-cambo: Cambo is refined and bookish, with only a modest swing in stroke weight. Under the ornate Almendra Display headings, its short step up to capitals keeps paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-almendra-display-gf-holtwood-one-sc: Open meets shut: Almendra Display never pinches its letters closed. Holtwood One SC is the stark opposite, with a towering lowercase, wide tracking and curves closed to a sliver.
